# Adapter Generation Policy

## Canonical Sources

- `AGENTS.md`
- `.agents/roles/`, `.agents/skills/`, `.agents/workflows/`, `.agents/tools/`

Tool-specific folders are generated adapters, not the source of truth.

## Rules

- Generated files carry the `Generated by engr-toolbox` header.
- Sync updates only files with that header. Delete the header line to own a file.
- `sync --clean` removes adapter skills that no longer exist canonically.
- `sync --check` fails when any adapter is out of date; CI runs it.
- If a tool's exact format is uncertain, generate conservative markdown and document the assumption.

## Command

```bash
node .ai/cli/bin/cli.mjs sync            # all tools in the installed config
node .ai/cli/bin/cli.mjs sync --target claude
node .ai/cli/bin/cli.mjs sync --check
```
